description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and installation of replacement rear roof gable windows to the existing single storey rear side extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  A25 (Rev P2); A26 (Rev P2); A27 (Rev P2); A28 (Rev P2); A29 (Rev P2); A30 (Rev P2); A200 (Rev P2); A800 (Rev P2)  Received:  24 August 2023;  A01 (Rev P1); A02 (Rev P1); A03 (Rev P1); A04 (P1); A05 (Rev P1); A06 (Rev P1); A07 (Rev P1)  Received:  14 June 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill extension and altered existing single storey rear side extension hereby approved.
